EU Green Claims Review Kit
Galaxy Forge Implementation Kit v1.0 (September 2026)

FILES
- empco_green_claims_kit_guide.pdf : main implementation guide
- empco_green_claims_kit_workbook.xlsx : Excel workbook (5 sheets)
- empco_claim_review_worksheet.docx : editable template
- empco_influencer_brief_addendum.docx : editable template
- empco_remediation_action_note.docx : editable template

HOW TO USE: start with Quick Start (section 2 of the guide), then work the 14-day plan in section 9.
SUPPORT: email support for file/usage questions within 7 days of purchase.
